scope: Headless fresh snapshots plus JS read-only inspection. Parent is concurrently rebuilding; findings apply to the listed snapshot hash, not an unobserved future rebuild.

p1Findings.problem: No prerequisite skill graph or evidence gate is implemented. Error tags only rank candidates; optional Test5 expansion does not diagnose/gate a Test9 prerequisite.
p1Findings.expected: Either label this explicitly as excluded from the current selection demonstration, or implement the narrowly reviewed prerequisites required by the prototype scope.

p1Findings.problem: A nonempty minute plan shorter than the requested budget has no shortage explanation/shorter-plan option, while count shortage is explicit.
p1Findings.expected: When candidate stock prevents using the budget, state the actual limited plan and why; keep scope expansion explicit.

observedChecks.check: Repeated old-A review begins with empty answer drafts while retaining archived prior session
Clicking already-selected teacher solved mode keeps 3 of 10
Entry correction B→C retains B history and full event payloads
Retry help=yes is stored and assisted=true
Returned material v1→new v2 preserves v1 and invalidates prior teacher review
Weekly attempt submitted after modeled window closes is rejected
Deadline closes invalid/raw draft and also closes off-stage/auth-closed exam
Actual inventory has 50 book items and correct Test9 Q9/Q10 blank-key counts
Correction targets original attemptId; a later wrong old-test first attempt adds power priority=2 and appears in errors proposal
Parent returned-material panel includes returned status and resubmission-required action

coverage.name: Use the real 100x100 V3 Test 9 A/B scope
coverage.availabilityDetail: Source inventory is real: Test9 10A/10B and Test5 15A/15B. Source truth was reviewed by the source agent; this audit checked counts/scaffold fields, not every source equation.

coverage.name: Source conflict or damaged formula
coverage.availabilityDetail: Fixed reviewed dataset only; no quarantine/source-conflict editor is demonstrated.

coverage.name: Teacher lesson scope is a subset, not the entire topic
coverage.availabilityDetail: A/B item selection exists before primary starts and locks thereafter; no lesson scope versions or optional makeup-extension list.

coverage.name: Attend class and backfill mixed paper answers
coverage.availabilityDetail: Paper-backfill origin, confidence/help/status and first-record submit are present; all learners remain synthetic.

coverage.name: Lost paper or cannot remember the original answer
coverage.availabilityDetail: Forgot and notdone exist; no distinct No paper marking category. Missing results do not become wrong.

coverage.name: Assigned but not attempted in class
coverage.availabilityDetail: Notdone is a noncorrectness status. A later retry exists, but no separate class-origin mixed item source or neutral assigned-not-attempted status.

coverage.name: Fast entry without inferred confidence
coverage.availabilityDetail: Current item with known context and unmarked defaults exists. Actual-child full-test 1–2 minute UX target is explicitly unverified.

coverage.name: Submit invalid root answer atomically
coverage.availabilityDetail: Submit builds rows before mutation and validates invalid fields before assigning records. This audit checked timeout invalid-input handling, not all ordinary invalid root formats.

coverage.name: Double tap and reload after initial submission
coverage.availabilityDetail: Submitted session guard prevents duplicate first submit; local run persistence is implemented. Full reload/double-tap case not executed here.

coverage.name: Separate transcription correction from mathematical retry
coverage.availabilityDetail: Original first records, repeat correction snapshots and full correction events are retained. Correction binds to the selected primary attemptId; later same-source attempts remain evidence. No transcription-reason input is modeled.

coverage.name: View solution and then enter the correct answer
coverage.availabilityDetail: First help is immutable and later shown solution flag/events attach to retries. Exact solution-open-close-reload case not run here.

coverage.name: External help without clicking the built-in solution
coverage.availabilityDetail: First and retry help declaration controls exist; retry help=yes produces assisted=true in fresh headless run.

coverage.name: Confident wrong versus guessed right
coverage.availabilityDetail: Tag priority distinguishes wrong from unsure/guessed/helped correct; no mastery percentage is asserted.

coverage.name: Multiple retries with the same error
coverage.availabilityDetail: Retry array retains multiple attempts; errors proposal uses a deduplicated source-ID set.

coverage.name: Assigned B work is separate from A paper backfill
coverage.availabilityDetail: B homework has a separate session and origin, reached after submitted A.

coverage.name: Five notebook photos modeled as one submission
coverage.availabilityDetail: Five static photo placeholders and one versioned material action; no choosing, ordering, previewing or actual scan/upload.

coverage.name: Unreadable or incomplete modeled material
coverage.availabilityDetail: Generic returned material and versioned resubmission preserve history; named page/replacement-page controls are excluded.

coverage.name: Teacher checks work rather than assigning mastery
coverage.availabilityDetail: Teacher completion differs from automatic correctness and binds to materialVersion; tested return/new-version clears prior grade.

coverage.name: Teacher revises a review
coverage.availabilityDetail: Teacher revision events contain the result, but no teacher change-reason/comment input.

coverage.name: Simple parent summary of one child
coverage.availabilityDetail: Synthetic parent panel separates first correctness/teacher completion and now displays returned material plus the required resubmission action.

coverage.name: Absent student makes up the exact lesson
coverage.availabilityDetail: Theory-read gate, exact A/B scope, makeup-web origins, original lesson date and separate attempt date exist; theory is a short reminder only.

coverage.name: Ill student pauses and resumes
coverage.availabilityDetail: Local pause/resume through persistence; Ill attendance choice exists without medical data.

coverage.name: Permitted absence and teacher review
coverage.availabilityDetail: Permitted/ill/absent attendance remains separate from completion; material purpose MAKEUP and teacher/parent panels exist.

coverage.name: Partial attendance or interrupted class
coverage.availabilityDetail: A session has one origin. Mixed per-item paper attendance/backfill plus online makeup in the same learner is not modeled.

coverage.name: Old lesson scope changed after absence
coverage.availabilityDetail: Scope locks after first start; no task/source scope revision reconciliation flow.

coverage.name: Online learner starts from an entitled book
coverage.availabilityDetail: Online entry bypasses paper gate and offers the two fixed source tests plus modeled entitlement; no full book catalogue.

coverage.name: First grade and second pass through wrong work
coverage.availabilityDetail: Fixed first results, wrong/uncertain default selection, retries and worked solutions exist. No dedicated filtered second-pass queue or videos.

coverage.name: Pause a topic test and resume without premature reveal
coverage.availabilityDetail: Draft/save/session state retains position and answers; no explicit Pause button. Exact reload sequence not executed here.

coverage.name: Rights expired or topic unavailable
coverage.availabilityDetail: Checkbox entitlement gates start/submit and retains local work; real expiry/product entitlement is excluded.

coverage.name: Three review entrances stay distinct
coverage.availabilityDetail: New/errors/old-A entrances are distinct within the run. Repeated old-A session now starts with blank drafts and preserves archive.

coverage.name: 10/30/60 minute plans respect available scope
coverage.availabilityDetail: 10/30/60 estimated time and stock are displayed, with count shortage warning. Time underfill has no dedicated shortage/shorter-plan message.

coverage.name: Count mode is alternative to time mode
coverage.availabilityDetail: Count overrides duration and stock shortage is explicit; no silent fill from extra topics unless foundation checked.

coverage.name: No evidence starts a short check
coverage.availabilityDetail: No-data proposals are general labeled starting checks, not learned personal ability.

coverage.name: Prerequisite gap limits the next problem
coverage.availabilityDetail: No prerequisite graph/evidence gate. Optional Test5 foundation checkbox is explicit scope expansion, not prerequisite-aware diagnosis.

coverage.name: Helped and guessed correct are provisional
coverage.availabilityDetail: Help/guess/unsure first answers affect priorities and no mastered verdict appears.

coverage.name: Slow correct learner is not weak
coverage.availabilityDetail: Times are general teacher-to-review estimates; paper entry/browser duration is explicitly not solving speed.

coverage.name: History after review changes later proposals
coverage.availabilityDetail: All archived session first records are read, exposures persist, and a correction suppresses only its target attemptId. New wrong same-source review records contribute to priorities and errors mode.

coverage.name: Choose a different topic explicitly
coverage.availabilityDetail: Explicit Test5 foundation expansion exists for Test9; arbitrary multi-topic selection is excluded.

coverage.name: Unseen check after corrected practice
coverage.availabilityDetail: Generated unexposed near-template probes hide results until finish; they are labeled limited near transfer.

coverage.name: Same numeric family versus independent transfer
coverage.availabilityDetail: Generated practice is visibly distinguished and family diversity is used. A truly independent held-out source transfer assessment is excluded.

coverage.name: Partial check or timer expiry
coverage.availabilityDetail: Missing outcomes remain null. Deadline auto-finishes invalid/raw drafts even off the primary stage and with rights closed.

coverage.name: Published weekly exam within rights/window
coverage.availabilityDetail: Window controls, modeled rights, local deadline, fixed A source scope and finish reveal exist; configurable release/pause policies and server schedule are excluded.

coverage.name: Outside window, already completed, or release pending
coverage.availabilityDetail: Before/closed start blocked; closed submission now blocked, deadline still auto-closes. Result-release-pending stage is excluded.

coverage.name: Avoid ranking incomparable personal plans
coverage.availabilityDetail: No leaderboard/comparison UI is built; therefore no ranking of incomparable tests is shown.

coverage.name: Root set accepts order and equivalent numeric forms
coverage.availabilityDetail: Numeric generated root-set parser accepts reordered roots, fractions, separators, braces, and deduplicates. Actual source choice items preserve their source choice format.

coverage.name: Scalar versus set and no-solution result
coverage.availabilityDetail: Typed choice/scalar/root/no-real/blanks formats exist; source aggregate items use their actual choice/scaffold format.

coverage.name: Substitution-domain and lost-root mistakes
coverage.availabilityDetail: Real source solutions/steps preserve complete roots. No reasoning-error inference or substitution-domain diagnosis engine is demonstrated.

coverage.name: Original multiple-choice input stays fast
coverage.availabilityDetail: A–E source choices render, while Test9 Q9/Q10 are actual digit scaffolds rather than invented multiple-choice.

coverage.name: Local save, storage failure, and modeled offline
coverage.availabilityDetail: Local save, failure label and export exist. No network/offline simulation control; no server claims. Storage-failure test not run here.

coverage.name: Role/profile/route switches and reset isolation
coverage.availabilityDetail: Route/test run isolation and confirmation before reset exist. Profiles share a run and are fixture-fill controls; authenticated role access is excluded.

coverage.name: One current item and compact progress on a phone
coverage.availabilityDetail: One current item/progress/picker, compact choices and draft controls exist. Narrow mobile/layout measurements belong to integration QA.

coverage.name: Accessible notation and navigation
coverage.availabilityDetail: Focus styles and some control labels exist. Complete screen-reader/zoom QA not run; some sibling labels have no for/id association.

coverage.name: Virtual delayed check stays a simulation
coverage.availabilityDetail: Delayed date is explicitly virtual and uses generated unexposed items; no retention/forgetting outcome is claimed.

coverage.name: Explicit Test 5 versus Test 9 source scope choice
coverage.availabilityDetail: Scope switch has actual 15/15 versus 10/10 source inventory and separate source limits. Combined exercise is explicit optional foundation expansion, not an arbitrary combined source-test UI.

coverage.name: Test 5 routine quadratic with two real roots
coverage.availabilityDetail: Source equation/solution/choice stored; raw root input for the book task is intentionally the original source choice format. No full source math re-verification by this agent.

coverage.name: Test 5 no real roots remains an explicit outcome
coverage.availabilityDetail: Source Test5 A3 is a no-real-roots task offered via actual source choices; generated none type uses explicit no-real text distinct from empty/0.

coverage.name: Test 5 irrational roots and exact equivalence
coverage.availabilityDetail: Exact radical source solution/choices render; no raw symbolic radical parser is claimed.

coverage.name: Test 5 decimal coefficients and fractional input
coverage.availabilityDetail: Source decimal-coefficient problem/choices/solutions included; numeric generated roots accept fraction form. Exact item input scenario not run.

coverage.name: Test 9 source digit-fill scaffolds
coverage.availabilityDetail: All four source digit scaffolds have the correct six/seven keyed digits in DATA; each digit checked independently. This audit checked inventory, not each full worked scaffold.

coverage.name: Test 9 even/odd powers and repeated roots
coverage.availabilityDetail: Source actual equations/roots/multiplicity/request type are included; source-agent math review supplies truth. This audit did not execute each answer case.

limits: These 60 rows describe possible scenario coverage and availability. No whole scenario is marked passed merely because code exists.
Real accounts, uploads, PDF compression, server sync, real teacher/parent messages, trained adaptive mastery, actual timed weekly exams and retention measurements remain excluded.
Source counts/scaffolds were checked in the loaded DATA. Source agent’s verified math is separate from this flow audit.
No production-security review was performed; the prototype clearly labels synthetic/local boundaries.

resolvedFindings.problem: A transcription correction is keyed to source problem ID and suppresses every later record of that problem, including a new incorrect first attempt in an old-test review.
reproduction: Use one-item Test9 A1 class scope; submit wrong original.
Start old-A review of that source item and submit another wrong answer.
priorities() returns {}, and errors filter excludes the new wrong record.
resolvedFindings.expected: Attach correction to the original attemptId (or origin/session), and suppress only that disputed record. Later attempts must remain evidence.

reproduction: Complete A and B in a modeled class run; submit material v1.
Read Parent panel: it displays зураг v1 илгээсэн while material.status=буцаасан.
resolvedFindings.expected: Display current material.status and the appropriate next action; preserve version and distinguish pending from needs resubmission.
